subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Crux Fleet crew member

726520101.text: Ho there, Traveler! How've you been? Interested in doing some work for the Crux Fleet?

726520104.text: Eh? Oh, right! Haha, my apologies.

726520105.text: I'm Muzhen, Chief Technical Officer of the Alcor. I spend most of my time below deck, so it's no surprise that you're not familiar with me.

726520106.text: Well, Sea Drake kicked me out and made me come outside, haha.

726520107.text: "Move those lazy bones of yours and go get some sun, it'll do you good!," he said. So here I am, on shore, thanks to him...

726520108.text: Hah! Not that he'd get off the boat himself though! Why, he'd faint the moment he sets foot on dry land.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Electro anomaly and complete the challenge
Reach the destination within the time limit

726520301.text: This should be the place Muzhen was talking about!
